---

The baubles [wemmuths](/Monsters.aspx?ID=408) use to lure victims to their hunting grounds are dangerous to retrieve and often stained by blood. One of these trinkets covers the plant matter created by [_entangling flora_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1515) with blood-drinking thorns. Creatures who fail or critically fail their Reflex saves against _entangling flora_ also take piercing damage equal to the spell's rank.
